title: 第25章 我特么这是穿越了第26章 不演了明牌
slug: 我只想毁灭宗门咋逆天成神了
lines: 昊天宫，昊天镜之前。
宗主顾明朝、大长老以及各宫首座长老此时全部都在这里。
而他们面前的昊天镜之上所出现的画面正是百人团的画面。
昊天宗虽为天下第一宗，可是楚星河他们这些小家伙们个个都是没有怎么见过世面的小毛头。
这种情况下宗门的长辈怎么可能完全放心的下。
虽然没有任何人提起这件事，可实际上他们从抵达禹城之后，所发生的一切事情都在这群大佬的默默关注之下。
而此时此刻看着昊天镜之中这一天一夜所发生的事情，所有人都沉默了。
最终还是宗主打破了沉寂。
“好啊……好啊……临危不惧，有勇有谋，毫不拖泥带水星河这个小家伙……好啊……”
宗主一连用了三个好啊。
大长老在一旁脸都快笑成菊花了。
一开始楚星河的命令被马良违背之后，马良被人偷袭受伤，说实话即便是大长老第一反应都是治马良个不尊领队，给宗门抹黑的罪名，这罪名可不轻啊。
楚星河要真的上报宗门，打不打入外门先不说，马良精英弟子的身份是肯定要被褫夺的。
而且他堂堂昊天宗弟子竟然被人偷袭一剑差点把胳膊都削断，即便回到宗门也必然成为所有师兄弟口中的笑柄。
可是楚星河没有这么做，带人第一时间杀到万花楼，火烧万花楼逼掌柜说出真凶的时候连大长老都惊呆了。
当时就有很多长老纳闷，楚星河为什么会认为掌柜的知道呢？
后来还是宗主为大家解惑答疑。
“星河这孩子脑子是真的快啊，万花盛会这样的大会，这万花楼的掌柜如果碰到正常的斗殴，必然是第一时间让护卫们制止，真要出现伤亡，拿下行凶者也肯定是必然。”
可万花楼当时怎么做的？连追都没追，管都没管，这要说掌柜的不知道对方是谁，鬼都不能信。
楚星河当时并不在现场，但从两个师弟的描述以及赶到现场之后的一些蛛丝马迹瞬间就做出了决定，一言不发先动手，以雷霆之势横扫整个万花楼，一下子打的万花楼是猝不及防。
而后蜡烛丢出点燃万花楼的做法也成为了压死骆驼的最后一根稻草，掌柜直接崩溃，根本不敢有丝毫隐瞒。
再之后所有人都猜测楚星河可能会将这件事上报宗门处理，可是大家又一次猜错了。
带领百人团，清晨轰开黄家大门，管你什么狗屁平远黄家分支，上去就给了一个五品武灵一个大比兜。
而最让宗主满意的是，楚星河在动手之前，先亮明身份，这才是他敢动手打五品武灵的最大底气。
事实证明楚星河做对了，什么狗屁灵石补偿，一概不要，砍我师弟一剑，必须断一条手作为代价。
当听到楚星河的要求之时，不少长老都忍不住摇头叹息啊。
“星河这孩子啊……还是太仁慈了……这要是我，不灭黄家满门，至少也要宰了这个黄少华啊……”
“张长老你这话就不对了，怎么就灭人满门，事情既然是黄少华做的，把他凌迟了也就是了，最多再把那个黄永华一起凌迟了，其他人每人砍一条手臂以示薄惩也就罢了。”
“张长老说的对啊，星河这孩子，什么都好，就是太心慈手软了！”
没有任何人觉得楚星河做法太过嚣张和霸道。
因为他们是天下第一宗昊天宗。
倘若此次楚星河真的知道黄家以后不敢上门，而是回来禀报宗门，虽然合情合理，但却真的会让大家失望。
你带着师弟出去了，先不说师弟是不是犯错了，你师弟让人砍了，你却连报仇都不敢，未来如何担起昊天宗的重担？
但今日，无论是宗主还是任何一个长老，对于楚星河的做法全都是无比满意。
他们这么多人在昊天镜之前其实也是想要看看楚星河以及这些弟子到底是什么秉性。
要知道，一些弟子在师门长辈面前那都是跟乖宝宝似的，可是出去以后呢？一个个跟特么脱缰的野狗似的，胡作非为的少吗？
楚星河此次身为领队，大家也很想知道，出门在外，自以为离开了师门长辈监视之下的楚星河又是什么样子？
而这一次楚星河的表现得到了所有人的认可。
这个孩子果然是秉性纯诚啊，在宗门什么样，在外面就什么样。
只要师兄弟有难，不惜一切代价也要出手，哪怕因此可能让自己受到天大的责罚，但楚星河依旧没有丝毫的退缩。
“这孩子洒脱，可是这会儿其他人都在担心因为错过灵窟时间而让楚星河受罚吧。”
“呵呵……你看看他们一个个小脸儿白的，面对黄家一个个都跟小老虎似的，面对宗门却吓成这样，你们以后对弟子也不要太过严苛，特别是你啊大长老。”
content_en:
Haotian Palace, in front of Haotian Mirror.
The sect leader Gu Mingchao, the great elder and the first elders of each palace are all here at this time.
And the picture that appeared on the Haotian Mirror in front of them was that of the Hundred People Group.
Although the Haotian Sect is the best sect in the world, Chu Xinghe and the others are all little ones who have never seen much of the world.
How could the elders of the sect be completely relieved under such circumstances.
Although no one mentioned this matter, in fact everything that happened since they arrived in Yucheng was under the silent attention of these big guys.
At this moment, everyone was silent as they looked at what happened that day and night in the Haotian Mirror.
In the end, it was the sect leader who broke the silence.
"Okay... okay... not afraid of danger, brave and resourceful, and never drags this little guy Shuixinghe... okay..."
The sect leader used three in a row.
The great elder looked at him with a smile on his face.
After Chu Xinghe's order was violated by Ma Liang at first, Ma Liang was attacked and injured. To be honest, even the great elder's first reaction was to punish Ma Liang for disrespecting the leader and smearing the sect. This crime is not light.
If Chu Xinghe really reported it to the sect, regardless of whether he could break into the outer sect or not, his status as an elite disciple of Ma Liang would definitely be taken away.
Moreover, he, a disciple of the Haotian Sect, was unexpectedly attacked and nearly cut off his arm with a sword. Even if he returned to the sect, he would definitely become the laughing stock of all his brothers.
But Chu Xinghe didn't do this. He led his people to Wanhua Tower immediately and burned Wanhua Tower to force the shopkeeper to reveal the real murderer. Even the elder was shocked.
At that time, many elders were wondering, why did Chu Xinghe think the shopkeeper knew?
Later, it was the sect leader who answered everyone's questions.
"This kid from Xinghe has a really quick mind. In a conference like the Wanhua Festival, if the shopkeeper of Wanhua Tower encounters a normal fight, he will definitely ask the guards to stop it as soon as possible. If there are serious casualties, it will definitely be inevitable to capture the perpetrator."
But what did Wanhualou do at that time? He didn't even chase him, and he didn't take care of him. If he said that the shopkeeper didn't know who the other party was, he couldn't believe it.
Chu Xinghe was not at the scene at the time, but based on the descriptions of the two junior brothers and some clues after arriving at the scene, he made an instant decision. Without saying a word, he struck first and swept across the entire Wanhua Tower with thunderous force. The attack on Wanhua Tower was caught off guard.
Then throwing candles to light up the Wanhua Building became the straw that broke the camel's back. The shopkeeper collapsed and didn't dare to hide anything.
After that, everyone guessed that Chu Xinghe might report the matter to the sect for handling, but everyone guessed wrong again.
Leading a group of 100 people, they blasted open the gate of the Huang family early in the morning. No matter what the hell, the Pingyuan Huang family branch went up and gave a fifth-grade martial spirit a big showdown.
What satisfied the sect leader the most was that Chu Xinghe first revealed his identity before taking action. This was the greatest confidence for him to dare to attack a fifth-grade martial spirit.
Facts have proved that Chu Xinghe did the right thing. He did not want any bullshit spiritual stone compensation. If he slashed my junior brother with a sword, he would have to cut off one of his hands as a price.
When hearing Chu Xinghe's request, many elders couldn't help but shake their heads and sigh.
"This kid Xinghe... is still too kind... If it were me, if I could not destroy the entire Huang family, I would at least kill this Huang Shaohua..."
"Elder Zhang, what you said is wrong. Why did you kill so many people? Since it was Huang Shaohua who did it, it's enough to torture him. At most, Huang Yonghua should be tortured too, and everyone else can chop off an arm as a light punishment."
"Elder Zhang is right, this kid Xinghe is good at everything, but he is too soft-hearted!"
No one thought that Chu Xinghe's behavior was too arrogant or overbearing.
Because they are the number one Haotian Sect in the world.
If this time Chu Xinghe really knew that the Huang family would not dare to come to the door in the future, but came back to report to the sect, although it would be reasonable, it would really disappoint everyone.
You took your junior brother out. Let’s not talk about whether his junior brother made a mistake. Your junior brother was killed by someone, but you didn’t even dare to take revenge. How will you shoulder the heavy responsibility of Haotian Sect in the future?
But today, both the sect leader and any of the elders were extremely satisfied with Chu Xinghe's actions.
So many of them actually wanted to see the nature of Chu Xinghe and these disciples before the Haotian Mirror.
You know, some disciples act like good babies in front of their elders, but what happens after they leave? Are they all acting like wild dogs on the loose? Are there too many of them misbehaving?
Chu Xinghe is the leader of the team this time, and everyone also wants to know what Chu Xinghe is like when he is away from home and thinks he is out of the surveillance of his master's elders.
But this time Chu Xinghe's performance was recognized by everyone.
This child is indeed pure and honest. What he is like in the sect is what he is like outside.
As long as his fellow apprentices are in trouble, he will take action at all costs. Even though he may be severely punished for this, Chu Xinghe still does not flinch at all.
"This kid is free and easy, but right now everyone else is worried about Chu Xinghe being punished for missing the time in the spiritual cave."
"Haha... Look at how pale their faces are. They are all like little tigers when facing the Huang family, but they are so scared when facing the sect. Don't be too harsh on your disciples in the future, especially you, the great elder."
title_en: Chapter 25: I have traveled through time Chapter 26: I no longer play the leading role
